audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0].text, early, and wants.you[1] all say Milio's Q cleanses/heals Bard's Cosmic Binding stun. Milio's Q is an offensive knockback/slow ball with no cleanse effect; the CC-removal ability is his R, Breath of Life (unlocked at level 6, per ownerKit R text).
audit.why: A reader would expect Q to save them from a wall-stun at level 1-2, which is impossible — Milio has no CC-cleanse that early.
audit.corrected: Reworded the affected lines to credit Q's actual knockback (early disruption) and E's shield charges (pre-shielding the combo), and left the level-6 R-cleanse claims (spikes[1].text, late) untouched since those already correctly cite R Breath of Life.
sources: ownerKit Q/E/R ability text in brief

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[2].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' while content.win[0], win[1], win[2] and win[6] read 'Milio' — and packet.levelChart (the same source win[] is drawn from) also reads Milio for all four rows. The two layers disagree on who wins levels 1, 2, 3 and 2+ items.
audit.why: A reader sees the level chart claim Milio one way and the prose row explain the opposite; win[] already matches the packet's ground truth, so full-layer side is the stale one.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0/1/2/6].side to Milio to match win[]/packet, rewriting phases[0].why and phases[1].why (previously generic, non-committal template text) to ground the new verdict in Milio's actual early tools; phases[2].why and phases[6].why already described a Milio advantage so were left as-is.
